## CI

Per-commit CI finishes within two minutes of a push, one minute ideally; everything that does not fit runs nightly with no time limit (Glenn, 2026-10-31).

### Per-commit CI within two minutes; the rest nightly

Move every per-commit job or step that does not finish well inside two minutes, queueing included, into a nightly workflow with no time limit, and enforce the budget per job. Measured on run 41231285519: the three Windows jobs took 2.5 to 3.7 minutes and the instruction count gate 7.1 minutes on a cold toolchain cache. Branch rowan/ci-under-two-minutes.

From: Glenn, live, 2026-10-31: "Each CI is 1m ideally, and 2m max"

## Audit items not yet fixed

Suspects from FABLE-AUDIT.md that no landed or in-flight change fixes yet. Each is verified at the cited line before it is fixed, and a confirmed defect gets a lock-in test and a negative control.

### Server-stop functional case asserts the send-failure counter did not move

The Windows cut-off of a flushed bank at stop (docs/audits/2026-10-24-area-transports-windows.md) was never reproduced on captain: the iocp and rio stop cases pass with the send_idle gate removed. Asserting in test_server_stop_disconnects_every_client_<transport> that the server's send-failure counter did not move during the stop gives that check a way to fail. A stopped server's transport stats are reachable only through the retiring transport, so it needs a small test accessor.

From: Stop-spread follow-on, rowan/stop-burst-across-updates at febf9c64

### Remove the resend FIFO's generation stamp and its check

RNResendGenerations (PR #783) shows the stamp never decides: the number comparison in rn_window_ack_on_ack is what refuses a stale ack. Removing it shrinks each resend entry from 12 to 8 bytes and drops two branches per acked number. Started and held, uncommitted, in the worktree rocketnet-remove-stamp on branch rowan/remove-resend-generation-stamp.

From: Audit item 12 follow-on; decided 2026-10-31

## Investigations that need a quiet host

Findings that only a quiet fleet host can measure or reproduce. They run after the landing frees the fleet.

### About 0.3% of client-to-server packets lost in the XDP receive path

Once the 1000-client xdp soak cell runs (PR #775), counters_agree fails: about 0.3% of client-to-server packets are lost in the XDP receive path. Measured with the host at load 170, so first reproduce it on a quiet host, then fix the cause.

From: Red-nightly work on audit item 41

### Low-tick nightly ends at 996 of 1000 connected

Reproduce on an idle Linux host with the per-client state output from rowan/nightly-lowtick, find the cause, fix it.

From: Red-nightly work on audit item 42

## Decisions for Glenn

Repository settings and fleet configuration that only Glenn changes.

### Branch protection on main

No ruleset or branch protection requires any check on main, so a red gate can be merged past (audit item 44). A repository setting, Glenn's to change.

From: Audit item 44

### A runner label for the nightly frame budget held only by amd-2 and amd-3

rocketnet-quiet now also covers hetzner2. Instruction counts do not depend on the host, but the frame budget is a wall-clock gate, so it compares only on one machine class. Fleet runner configuration, Glenn's to change.

From: Instruction gate work, PR #731
